integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite critical group of the specified geometric, unweighted, 85-vertex complex Burkhardt node–Jacobi-plane incidence graph
integrity.proof_method: Exhaustive finite geometric incidence reconstruction, Gram-matrix spectral identity, matrix-tree theorem, and exact modular Smith elimination at each possible torsion prime
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library Python program burkhardt_critical_verify.py; no unpublished inputs
scientific_limitations: Not the threefold Picard, Brauer or divisor class group
Only the complex geometric configuration; not a classification of arithmetic twists
Exact computation, not a general parametric Smith theorem
Historical literature could contain an equivalent unindexed Smith computation
The full 1990 de Jong–Shepherd-Barron–van de Ven paper was not inspected
No independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed

title: Integral critical group of the Burkhardt node–Jacobi-plane incidence graph
